messages:
Olivia: Heads-up — pulled the post-launch telemetry and backlog. Need a quick sync to decide sprint split for the next 2 weeks: bugs (debt) vs customer asks vs small delights.

Devin: Agree. Propose a simple triage rubric to be applied to all incoming items this sprint: severity (S0/S1), customer count affected, regression flag, and operational load (pager frequency / SLO exposure).

Marta: Draft rubric:
- S0 must-fix: security/data-loss, outage-causing regressions, >=3 paying customers impacted
- S1 customer-blocker: single-customer with contract / renewal risk
- S2 backlog/debt: known issues with workarounds
- S3 delight: UX polish, perf wins with minor user impact

Samir: Telemetry: tokenizer error rate spike in eu-west — counts: 128 -> 312 over 48h, 5004 log entries. Looks like regression after rollout-2026-03-18.

Devin: If tokenizer regression increases retries, that's S0/S1. Need scoped investigation before we commit to full rollback.

Olivia: Capacity proposal for this iteration: Option A: 50% must-fix, 30% customer-asks, 20% delights. Option B (Marta): 40/40/20 with on-call overlap reserved. Vote: which?

Marta: I prefer B — the renewal risk trumps pure defects here. We should freeze scope for new enhancements unless triaged.

Devin: Operational ask: require acceptance criteria on customer-ask tickets: reproduction steps, expected behavior, risk/rollback plan, and required QA.

Olivia: Agreed. I'll add an acceptance criteria template to the board.

Samir: I'll pick up tokenizer investigation and target a patch in 48–72h if root cause is model packaging. Creating ticket now: https://pm.redwood/t/1234

product-bot: Board created: https://pm.redwood/boards/iter-1749993333 columns: must-fix, customer-asks, delights, blocked

Devin: Also adding a short eval hook for embedding drift alerts — quick stopgap to avoid noisy manual triage. ETA EOD.

Marta: Owners for the sprint: Samir (tokenizer + memory leak triage), Devin (rate-limit fairness prototype + embedding eval), Olivia (grooming + acceptance criteria + patch release plan), Marta (release coordination + oncall handoff).

Olivia: Plan: 10-day stabilization -> canary -> patch release if canary and CI green. Any objections?

Devin: No objections.

Marta: Fine from product. :+1:

Olivia: Action items: 1) Samir opens PR and links logs; 2) Devin wires embedding eval; 3) I create tickets and assign; 4) Freeze new feature work until after stabilization window. Grooming in 30m.

product-bot: Reminder: grooming session in 30m — channel #product — agenda attached.
